title: Adaptive Traffic Signal Control System Utilizing Real-Time Vehicle Trajectory and Density Prediction
abstract: An intelligent urban traffic signal optimization system that receives continuous vehicle telemetries, executes neural network trajectory predictions at intersection nodes, and dynamically modulates green signal intervals to minimize congestion queues.
claims: 1. An intelligent traffic signal controller comprising: an intersection sensor array capturing vehicle queue densities; an edge processing engine running predictive arrival heuristics; and a signal phase modulator adjusting phase timings dynamically.

title: Decentralized Connected Vehicle Traffic Flow Optimization Using Edge Computing Nodes
abstract: A distributed traffic management system where roadside edge computing units communicate with connected vehicles via V2X protocols to establish coordinated platoons and optimize corridor progression without centralized bottleneck servers.
claims: 1. A roadside edge computing unit comprising: a V2X wireless transceiver; a corridor progression optimizer; and an encrypted telemetry interface linked to adjacent intersection units.

title: Machine Learning Method for Dynamic Signal Phase and Timing (SPaT) Allocation
abstract: A reinforcement learning architecture for arterial traffic network control that continuously updates Q-learning policy matrices based on real-time pedestrian presence, emergency vehicle preemption, and transit priority telemetries.
claims: 1. A computer-implemented signal allocation method: receiving real-time multi-modal traffic data; computing reward functions based on corridor delays; and adjusting signal phases according to learned policy parameters.

title: Decentralized trust verification system using distributed consensus ledger
abstract: A system and method for verifying digital assets using a distributed consensus ledger. The system generates secure consensus keys, registers transactions, and validates ownership metadata using cryptographic hashing across public nodes.
claims:
1. A computer-implemented consensus system comprising: a distributed cryptographic ledger; a plurality of network nodes; and a smart contract executing trust verification steps...
2. The system of claim 1, wherein consensus is achieved using proof-of-stake verification keys.

title: Deep learning model training optimization using dynamic batch size adaptation
abstract: An artificial intelligence training pipeline that monitors validation error curves and automatically adjusts gradient batch sizes. It scales resource allocation dynamically to prevent overfitting in multi-layer neural network architectures.
claims: 1. A method for deep neural network training optimization: monitoring a validation loss parameter; and adapting a batch size parameter dynamically during gradient descent iterations.

title: Method for predictive energy load balancing in smart electrical grids
abstract: A smart-grid optimization technique utilizing neural networks to forecast local energy demand spikes. The system reroutes storage battery output during peak periods to maintain frequency stability and balance transmission line loads.
claims: 1. A power management controller configured to: collect sensor measurements from power distribution nodes; and trigger local battery storage output balancing using predictive models.

title: Secure data transmission protocol in low-power wireless sensor networks
abstract: An encrypted routing scheme for Internet-of-Things (IoT) micro-controllers. The protocol employs rotating cryptographic salts and dynamic route hopping to secure communication across mesh topology networks against sniffing attacks.
claims: 1. An IoT communication protocol comprising: generating a dynamic session salt; encrypting data frames at sensor nodes; and scheduling randomized multi-hop transmission paths.

title: Machine learning system for anomaly detection in electronic health records
abstract: A natural language processing framework that parses medical charts to highlight contradictory prescriptions, critical laboratory value discrepancies, and unrecognized patient history flags, outputting safety risk scores.
claims: 1. A medical diagnostics server comprising: an ingestion pipeline parsing EHR logs; a feature extraction classifier; and a decision tree yielding warning events.

title: Image classification assistant using edge computing nodes
abstract: A distributed computer vision architecture where light feature extraction maps are generated on edge micro-cameras, and heavy tensor matrix classifications are delegated to centralized cloud servers.
claims: 1. A hardware-efficient computer vision system comprising: an edge sensor computing local kernel weights; and a network interface transmitting feature vectors to a remote host.

title: Autonomous vehicle collision avoidance system based on LIDAR cloud density
abstract: A driverless guidance system that maps points from 3D LIDAR scans into dense point clouds, dynamically calculates occupancy maps, and triggers backup braking when dense clusters are resolved in the travel trajectory.
claims: 1. An vehicle safety controller comprising: a LIDAR transceiver mapping 3D arrays; and a processing unit identifying obstacles within braking zones.
